*CloudCore Networks organisational chart, 2022. Reviewed 10-01-2022.*

## Organisational structure — 2022

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    CEO["Marcell Ziemann<br/>Chief Executive Officer"]

    CEO --> CTO["Mark Gonzalez<br/>Chief Technology Officer"]
    CEO --> CFO["Aisha Rahman<br/>Chief Financial Officer"]
    CEO --> CDO["Priya Nair<br/>Chief Data Officer"]
    CEO --> OPS["James Whitfield<br/>Director of Operations"]

    CTO --> CISO["Sophia Martines<br/>Chief Information Security Officer"]
    CTO --> DEV["Michael Thompson<br/>Lead Developer"]
    CTO --> ITM["Raj Patel<br/>IT Manager"]
    CTO --> ARCH["David Wilson<br/>Infrastructure Architect"]

    CDO --> DATA["Jamal Al-Sayed<br/>Data Analyst"]
    CDO --> BI["Analytics Team"]

    OPS --> SUP["Support Team"]
    OPS --> HR["HR"]
```

## Reporting notes

- Technology, security, and engineering report to the Chief Technology Officer.
- The Chief Data Officer owns data and analytics.
- Operations, including support and HR, report to the Director of Operations.

*Currency: AUD. Organisational chart, 10-01-2022.*
